details.description: Choco Vanilla Cornetto Frozen Dessert is a delightful combination of creamy vanilla-flavoured frozen dessert, rich chocolate layers, and crunchy chocolate chips, served in a crispy wafer cone. Finished with a delicious chocolate coating and indulgent chocolatey centre, this classic treat offers a perfect balance of creamy, crunchy, and chocolaty flavours in every bite. Ideal for enjoying as a refreshing dessert or a sweet indulgence anytime.
